#models
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)

set.seed(123)

# =========================
# 0) Llegir dades i tipus
# =========================
dades <- read.csv2("dades_imputades.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE)

dades$Balance              <- as.numeric(dades$Balance)
dades$AvgTransactionAmount <- as.numeric(dades$AvgTransactionAmount)
dades$EstimatedSalary      <- as.numeric(dades$EstimatedSalary)

dades$Geography       <- factor(dades$Geography)
dades$Gender          <- factor(dades$Gender)
dades$CustomerSegment <- factor(dades$CustomerSegment)
dades$EducationLevel  <- factor(dades$EducationLevel)
dades$LoanStatus      <- factor(dades$LoanStatus)
dades$MaritalStatus   <- factor(dades$MaritalStatus)

# =========================
# 1) Split train/test
# =========================
df_tr <- dades %>% filter(Group == "train")
df_te <- dades %>% filter(Group == "test")

# =========================
# 2) Variables
# =========================
vars_x <- c("Geography", "Balance", "Age",
            "IsActiveMember", "NumOfProducts",
            "NetPromoterScore", "Gender")

df_tr$Exited <- factor(df_tr$Exited, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes"))

# =========================
# 3) Dummies
# =========================
dmy <- caret::dummyVars(~ ., data = df_tr[, vars_x, drop = FALSE], fullRank = TRUE)

X_tr <- as.data.frame(predict(dmy, newdata = df_tr[, vars_x, drop = FALSE]))
X_te <- as.data.frame(predict(dmy, newdata = df_te[, vars_x, drop = FALSE]))

train_forest <- cbind(Exited = df_tr$Exited, X_tr)
test_forest  <- X_te

# =========================
# 4) Validació interna 70/30
# =========================
idx <- createDataPartition(train_forest$Exited, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_in <- train_forest[idx, ]
val_in   <- train_forest[-idx, ]

# =========================
# 5) BAGGING (mtry = totes)
# =========================
bagtrees <- randomForest(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_in,
  mtry = ncol(train_in) - 1,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

print(bagtrees)
plot(bagtrees, main = "Bagging Trees - OOB Error (train_in)")

# =========================
# 6) Avaluació VALIDACIÓ
# =========================
pred_val <- predict(bagtrees, newdata = val_in)
cm_val <- confusionMatrix(pred_val, val_in$Exited, positive = "Yes")
print(cm_val)

# =========================
# 6b) ROC + AUC VALIDACIÓ
# =========================
probs_val <- predict(bagtrees, newdata = val_in, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]
roc_obj <- roc(val_in$Exited, probs_val)
auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))

# =========================
# 6c) TAULA DE MÈTRIQUES (TRAIN / VALIDACIÓ)
# =========================

# TRAIN (mateix model)
pred_train <- predict(bagtrees, newdata = train_in)
cm_train <- confusionMatrix(pred_train, train_in$Exited, positive = "Yes")

resultats_bagging <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Train", "Validation"),
  Accuracy = c(
    cm_train$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_val$overall["Accuracy"]
  ),
  Precision = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Precision"],
    cm_val$byClass["Precision"]
  ),
  Specificity = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Specificity"],
    cm_val$byClass["Specificity"]
  ),
  Recall = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Sensitivity"],
    cm_val$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  ),
  F1 = c(
    cm_train$byClass["F1"],
    cm_val$byClass["F1"]
  ),
  Kappa = c(
    cm_train$overall["Kappa"],
    cm_val$overall["Kappa"]
  ),
  AUC = c(
    NA,
    auc_val
  )
)

print(resultats_bagging)

# =========================
# 7) MODEL FINAL (TOT TRAIN)
# =========================
bagtrees_final <- randomForest(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_forest,
  mtry = ncol(train_forest) - 1,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

# =========================
# 8) PREDICCIÓ TEST KAGGLE
# =========================
pred_test <- predict(bagtrees_final, newdata = test_forest)

submission_bag <- data.frame(
  ID = df_te$ID,
  Exited = pred_test
)

write.csv(submission_bag,
          "submission_bagging_rf.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

submission_bag

```



#RANDOM FOREST + CARET + VALIDACIÓ + SUBMISSION 
````{r}
############################################
## RANDOM FOREST + CARET COMPLET I NET     ##
############################################

library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)

set.seed(123)

# =========================
# 0) Llegir dades
# =========================
dades <- read.csv2("dades_imputades.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE)

dades$Balance              <- as.numeric(dades$Balance)
dades$AvgTransactionAmount <- as.numeric(dades$AvgTransactionAmount)
dades$EstimatedSalary      <- as.numeric(dades$EstimatedSalary)

dades$Geography       <- factor(dades$Geography)
dades$Gender          <- factor(dades$Gender)
dades$CustomerSegment <- factor(dades$CustomerSegment)
dades$EducationLevel  <- factor(dades$EducationLevel)
dades$LoanStatus      <- factor(dades$LoanStatus)
dades$MaritalStatus   <- factor(dades$MaritalStatus)

# =========================
# 1) Split train / test
# =========================
df_tr <- dades %>% filter(Group == "train")
df_te <- dades %>% filter(Group == "test")

df_tr$Exited <- factor(df_tr$Exited, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes"))

# =========================
# 2) Variables
# =========================
vars_x <- c("Geography", "Balance", "Age",
            "IsActiveMember", "NumOfProducts",
            "NetPromoterScore", "Gender")

# =========================
# 3) Dummies
# =========================
dmy <- dummyVars(~ ., data = df_tr[, vars_x], fullRank = TRUE)

X_tr <- as.data.frame(predict(dmy, df_tr[, vars_x]))
X_te <- as.data.frame(predict(dmy, df_te[, vars_x]))

train_forest <- cbind(Exited = df_tr$Exited, X_tr)
test_forest  <- X_te

# =========================
# 4) Validació interna 70/30
# =========================
idx <- createDataPartition(train_forest$Exited, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_in <- train_forest[idx, ]
val_in   <- train_forest[-idx, ]

# =========================
# 5) Control caret
# =========================
ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 5,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary
)

# =========================
# 6) Grid mtry
# =========================
grid_rf <- expand.grid(
  mtry = c(3, 5, 7)
)

# =========================
# 7) Entrenament RF (caret)
# =========================
rf_caret <- train(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_in,
  method = "rf",
  metric = "ROC",
  trControl = ctrl,
  tuneGrid = grid_rf,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

print(rf_caret)
plot(rf_caret)

# =========================
# 8) Avaluació VALIDACIÓ
# =========================
pred_val <- predict(rf_caret, newdata = val_in)
cm_val <- confusionMatrix(pred_val, val_in$Exited, positive = "Yes")
print(cm_val)

# =========================
# 8b) ROC + AUC VALIDACIÓ
# =========================
probs_val <- predict(rf_caret, newdata = val_in, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]
roc_obj <- roc(val_in$Exited, probs_val)
auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))

# =========================
# 8c) TAULA MÈTRIQUES TRAIN / VALIDACIÓ
# =========================

# TRAIN (mateix model)
pred_train <- predict(rf_caret, newdata = train_in)
cm_train <- confusionMatrix(pred_train, train_in$Exited, positive = "Yes")

resultats_rf_caret <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Train", "Validation"),
  Accuracy = c(
    cm_train$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_val$overall["Accuracy"]
  ),
  Precision = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Precision"],
    cm_val$byClass["Precision"]
  ),
  Specificity = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Specificity"],
    cm_val$byClass["Specificity"]
  ),
  Recall = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Sensitivity"],
    cm_val$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  ),
  F1 = c(
    cm_train$byClass["F1"],
    cm_val$byClass["F1"]
  ),
  Kappa = c(
    cm_train$overall["Kappa"],
    cm_val$overall["Kappa"]
  ),
  AUC = c(
    NA,
    auc_val
  )
)

print(resultats_rf_caret)

# =========================
# 9) MODEL FINAL (TOT TRAIN)
# =========================
rf_final <- train(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_forest,
  method = "rf",
  metric = "ROC",
  trControl = ctrl,
  tuneGrid = rf_caret$bestTune,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

# =========================
# 10) PREDICCIÓ TEST KAGGLE
# =========================
pred_test <- predict(rf_final, newdata = test_forest)

submission_rf_caret <- data.frame(
  ID = df_te$ID,
  Exited = pred_test
)

write.csv(submission_rf_caret,
          "submission_rf_caret.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

submission_rf_caret

````

#RANDOM FOREST + CARET + MTRY OPTIMITZAT (SENSE DATA LEAKAGE)
````{r}
############################################
## RANDOM FOREST + CARET + MTRY OPTIMITZAT ##
############################################

library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)

set.seed(123)

# =========================
# 1) Heurística mtry
# =========================
p <- ncol(train_in) - 1
mtry_base <- floor(sqrt(p))

tuneGrid <- expand.grid(
  mtry = unique(floor(c(mtry_base/2, mtry_base, 2*mtry_base)))
)

# =========================
# 2) Control caret (ROC + CV)
# =========================
ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 5,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final"
)

# =========================
# 3) Entrenament (NOMÉS train_in)
# =========================
rf_caret <- train(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_in,
  method = "rf",
  metric = "ROC",
  tuneGrid = tuneGrid,
  trControl = ctrl,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

print(rf_caret)
plot(rf_caret)

# =========================
# 4) PREDICCIONS TRAIN
# =========================
pred_train <- predict(rf_caret, newdata = train_in)
cm_train <- confusionMatrix(pred_train, train_in$Exited, positive = "Yes")

# =========================
# 5) PREDICCIONS TEST (val_in)
# =========================
pred_test <- predict(rf_caret, newdata = val_in)
cm_test <- confusionMatrix(pred_test, val_in$Exited, positive = "Yes")

# =========================
# 6) ROC + AUC (TEST)
# =========================
probs_test <- predict(rf_caret, newdata = val_in, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]
roc_test <- roc(val_in$Exited, probs_test)
auc_test <- as.numeric(auc(roc_test))

plot(
  roc_test,
  print.auc = TRUE,
  main = "ROC - Validation (RF mtry opt)"
)

# =========================
# 7) TAULA FINAL TRAIN / TEST
# =========================
resultats_rf_mtry_opt <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Train", "Test"),
  Accuracy = c(
    cm_train$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_test$overall["Accuracy"]
  ),
  Precision = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Precision"],
    cm_test$byClass["Precision"]
  ),
  Recall = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Recall"],
    cm_test$byClass["Recall"]
  ),
  F1 = c(
    cm_train$byClass["F1"],
    cm_test$byClass["F1"]
  ),
  Kappa = c(
    cm_train$overall["Kappa"],
    cm_test$overall["Kappa"]
  ),
  AUC = c(
    NA,
    auc_test
  )
)

print(resultats_rf_mtry_opt)

# =========================
# 8) MODEL FINAL (TOT el train)
# =========================
rf_final <- train(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_forest,
  method = "rf",
  metric = "ROC",
  tuneGrid = rf_caret$bestTune,
  trControl = ctrl,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

# =========================
# 9) PREDICCIÓ TEST KAGGLE
# =========================
pred_kaggle <- predict(rf_final, newdata = test_forest)

submission_rf_opt <- data.frame(
  ID = df_te$ID,
  Exited = pred_kaggle
)

write.csv(
  submission_rf_opt,
  "submission_rf_caret_mtry_opt.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

submission_rf_opt

````

## RANDOM FOREST + CARET + SMOTE
```{r}
############################################
## RANDOM FOREST + CARET + SMOTE COMPLET  ##
############################################

library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)

set.seed(123)

# =========================
# 1) Grid mtry (heurística)
# =========================
p <- ncol(train_in) - 1
mtry_base <- floor(sqrt(p))

grid_rf <- expand.grid(
  mtry = unique(floor(c(mtry_base/2, mtry_base, 2*mtry_base)))
)

# =========================
# 2) Control caret amb SMOTE
# =========================
ctrl_smote <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 5,
  sampling = "smote",
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final"
)

# =========================
# 3) Entrenament (NOMÉS train_in)
# =========================
rf_smote <- train(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_in,
  method = "rf",
  metric = "ROC",
  tuneGrid = grid_rf,
  trControl = ctrl_smote,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

print(rf_smote)
plot(rf_smote)

# =========================
# 4) PREDICCIONS TRAIN
# =========================
pred_train <- predict(rf_smote, newdata = train_in)
cm_train <- confusionMatrix(pred_train, train_in$Exited, positive = "Yes")

# =========================
# 5) PREDICCIONS TEST (val_in)
# =========================
pred_test <- predict(rf_smote, newdata = val_in)
cm_test <- confusionMatrix(pred_test, val_in$Exited, positive = "Yes")

# =========================
# 6) ROC + AUC (TEST)
# =========================
probs_test <- predict(rf_smote, newdata = val_in, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]
roc_test <- roc(val_in$Exited, probs_test)
auc_test <- as.numeric(auc(roc_test))

plot(roc_test,
     print.auc = TRUE,
     main = "ROC - Validation (RF + SMOTE)")

# =========================
# 7) TAULA FINAL TRAIN / TEST
# =========================
resultats_rf_smote <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Train", "Test"),
  Accuracy = c(
    cm_train$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_test$overall["Accuracy"]
  ),
  Precision = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Precision"],
    cm_test$byClass["Precision"]
  ),
  Recall = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Recall"],
    cm_test$byClass["Recall"]
  ),
  F1 = c(
    cm_train$byClass["F1"],
    cm_test$byClass["F1"]
  ),
  Kappa = c(
    cm_train$overall["Kappa"],
    cm_test$overall["Kappa"]
  ),
  AUC = c(
    NA,
    auc_test
  )
)

print(resultats_rf_smote)

# =========================
# 8) MODEL FINAL (TOT el train)
# =========================
rf_final_smote <- train(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_forest,
  method = "rf",
  metric = "ROC",
  tuneGrid = rf_smote$bestTune,
  trControl = ctrl_smote,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

# =========================
# 9) PREDICCIÓ TEST KAGGLE
# =========================
pred_kaggle <- predict(rf_final_smote, newdata = test_forest)

submission_rf_smote <- data.frame(
  ID = df_te$ID,
  Exited = pred_kaggle
)

write.csv(
  submission_rf_smote,
  "submission_rf_smote.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

submission_rf_smote


```
